## 🏗️ 1953 - 1989: Origins & The "Seed Money"
*   **1953 (Jan 20)**: Jeffrey Epstein born in Brooklyn, NY.
*   **1974**: Hired at the **Dalton School** as a math/physics teacher by Headmaster **Donald Barr** (father of future AG Bill Barr), despite having no college degree.
*   **1976**: Fired/Resigns from Dalton. Hired at **Bear Stearns** (Wall Street).
*   **1980**: Becomes a Limited Partner at Bear Stearns.
*   **1981**: Resigns from Bear Stearns due to minor regulatory infractions.
*   **1982**: **J. Epstein & Co.** is founded.
*   **1987**: Epstein is hired as a consultant by **Steven Hoffenberg** at **Towers Financial**.
    *   *Significance*: This is the likely source of his initial millions. Towers was a massive Ponzi scheme.
*   **1980s (Late)**: Epstein meets **Les Wexner** (The Limited/Victoria's Secret).
*   **1989**: Epstein "exits" Towers Financial before it collapses. Hoffenberg later claims Epstein took stolen millions with him.

---

## 💰 1990 - 1999: The Empire Building
*   **1991 (Nov 5)**: **Robert Maxwell** (Ghislaine's father) dies mysteriously off his yacht. Given a state funeral in Israel (attended by 6 intel heads).
*   **1991**: Les Wexner grants Epstein **Full Power of Attorney**.
*   **1991**: Ghislaine Maxwell moves to New York; begins relationship with Epstein.
*   **1993**: Towers Financial collapses; Hoffenberg arrested (later sentenced to 20 years). Epstein is not charged.
*   **1994**: Earliest alleged abuse dates (according to later lawsuits).
*   **1995**: **Maria Farmer** is hired. Allegedly meets **Donald Trump** at Epstein's office (reported to FBI).
*   **1996 (Summer)**: **Maria Farmer** is assaulted at Wexner's Ohio estate. She flees and files a report with the **FBI** and **NYPD**.
    *   *Outcome*: The report is ignored.
*   **1995-1998**: Epstein transfers the **Manhattan Townhouse** and the **Boeing 727** ("Lolita Express") from Wexner's companies to his own name for $0.
*   **1998**: Epstein buys **Little St. James** (USVI) for $7.95 million.
*   **1998**: **JPMorgan Chase** accepts Epstein as a private banking client.

---

## ✈️ 2000 - 2005: The "Golden Era"
*   **2000**: **Virginia Giuffre** (age 16) is recruited from Mar-a-Lago (Trump's club) by Ghislaine Maxwell.
*   **2001**: **Prince Andrew** visits Epstein's NY townhouse. The infamous "puppet photo" with Johanna Sjoberg is taken.
*   **2001-2003**: The **Bill Clinton Flights**.
    *   Clinton flies on Epstein's plane ~26 times (Africa trip, Asia trip).
    *   Passengers include Kevin Spacey, Chris Tucker.
    *   *Secret Service*: Agents fly with him, but no reports of misconduct are filed.
*   **2002**: Donald Trump "Terrific Guy" quote in *New York Magazine*.
*   **2002**: The "Helicopter Incident." Epstein lands a helicopter on the roof of the Standard Hotel (NY) with a young girl.
*   **2004**: **Ehud Barak** (Israeli PM) receives $2.3 million from the Wexner Foundation for "research."
*   **2004**: Reported "rift" between Trump and Epstein (Maison de L'Amitie property dispute).
*   **2005**: **The Palm Beach Investigation Begins**.
    *   Parent complains to police.
    *   **Chief Michael Reiter** launches "Operation 12-20."
    *   Detectives pull Epstein's trash, finding notes from victims.

## ⚖️ 2006 - 2009: The "Sweetheart Deal"
*   **2006 (May)**: FBI opens "Operation Leap Year" (Federal investigation).
*   **2007**: U.S. Attorney **Alexander Acosta** drafts a 53-page federal indictment (Sex Trafficking).
*   **2007-2008**: **The Negotiations**.
    *   Epstein hires Alan Dershowitz, Ken Starr.
    *   Acosta agrees to the **Non-Prosecution Agreement (NPA)**.
    *   *Terms*: 18 months jail, immunity for "co-conspirators" (Maxwell, Kellen, etc.).
*   **2008 (Jun)**: Epstein pleads guilty to state charges (Solicitation).
*   **2008 (July)**: **Jes Staley** (JPMorgan) sends "Snow White" emails to Epstein.
*   **2008-2009**: Epstein serves 13 months in Palm Beach County Jail.
    *   *Work Release*: Leaves jail 12 hours a day, 6 days a week.
    *   *Parties*: The Dubins host him for Thanksgiving (2009).

## 🔬 2010 - 2018: The "Rehabilitation" & Science Club
*   **2010**: Prince Andrew photographed walking with Epstein in Central Park (post-conviction).
*   **2010**: Epstein pays off **Sarah Ferguson's** £15,000 debt.
*   **2011**: **Virginia Giuffre** files her first civil lawsuit (dismissed/settled).
*   **2011**: **Bill Gates** begins meeting with Epstein (New York townhouse).
*   **2012**: Ghislaine Maxwell founds **The TerraMar Project** (UN Ocean charity).
*   **2012-2017**: **Leon Black** pays Epstein **$158 million** for "tax advice."
*   **2013**: **JPMorgan Chase** finally drops Epstein as a client due to compliance flags.
*   **2013**: **Deutsche Bank** picks Epstein up as a client.
*   **2013-2016**: **Yoni Koren** (Israeli Intel) visits Epstein's NY home.
*   **2014**: **Reid Hoffman** visits Little St. James with MIT scientists.
*   **2015**: **Giuffre v. Maxwell** defamation suit filed (The source of the 2024 files).
*   **2015-2017**: **Kathryn Ruemmler** (Obama WH Counsel) exchanges "adoration" emails with Epstein.
*   **2016**: **Great St. James Island** purchased for $22 million.
*   **2016**: Emails show Epstein discussing "demographic threats" and eugenics with Mega Group members.
*   **2018**: Epstein tries to insert himself into Elon Musk's "Tesla Privatization" deal with the Saudis.
*   **2018 (Nov)**: **Julie K. Brown** (Miami Herald) publishes "Perversion of Justice," exposing the 2008 plea deal.

## 🚨 2019: The Fall
*   **July 6**: Epstein arrested at Teterboro Airport (NJ) returning from Paris.
    *   *Raid*: FBI finds the Safe (Saudi Passport, Diamonds, Cash, CDs).
*   **July 8**: Federal Indictment unsealed (SDNY).
*   **July 12**: **TerraMar Project** shuts down (6 days after arrest).
*   **July 18**: Bail denied.
*   **July 23**: **The First Incident**. Epstein found with neck marks. Cellmate **Nicholas Tartaglione** claims he saved him. Surveillance video "goes missing."
*   **July 29**: Epstein removed from Suicide Watch.
*   **Aug 8**: Epstein creates the **"1953 Trust"**, moving $577M into it (witnessed by Indyke & Kahn).
*   **Aug 9**: Cellmate transferred out; no replacement.
*   **Aug 10**: **The Death**.
    *   6:30 AM: Found unresponsive.
    *   8:16 AM: **4chan Leak** announces death before news media.
*   **Aug 16**: Officially ruled Suicide by Hanging.
*   **Nov 19**: Two MCC correctional officers are charged in federal court with falsifying records related to prison checks the night before Epstein's death.
*   **Nov**: Prince Andrew gives disastrous BBC interview ("No Sweat").

## 🏛️ 2020 - 2023: Justice & Settlements
*   **2020 (Jul)**: Ghislaine Maxwell arrested in New Hampshire.
*   **2021 (Dec)**: **Ghislaine Maxwell Trial**.
    *   Pilots testify.
    *   Maxwell found **Guilty** on 5 of 6 counts.
*   **2022 (Feb)**: **Prince Andrew** settles with Giuffre (paid in part by Queen Elizabeth II).
*   **2022 (Feb)**: **Jean-Luc Brunel** found dead in Paris prison (Suicide).
*   **2022 (May)**: **Mark Middleton** (Clinton aide) found dead (Shotgun/Hanging).
*   **2022 (Jun)**: Maxwell sentenced to 20 years.
*   **2022 (Aug)**: **Steven Hoffenberg** found dead (Natural causes).
*   **2023 (May/Jun)**: **The Bank Settlements**.
    *   Deutsche Bank pays $75M.
    *   JPMorgan pays $290M.
    *   **Jes Staley** banned from banking.
*   **2023 (May)**: **Stephen Deckoff** buys the islands for $60 million.
*   **2023 (Jun)**: DOJ OIG issues a major report detailing systemic Bureau of Prisons failures in custody, supervision, and staffing tied to Epstein's detention.

## 📂 2024 - 2026: The Files Open
*   **2024 (Jan)**: **The "Giuffre" Release**.
    *   ~900 pages unsealed.
    *   Viral debunking: Hawking (No orgy), Jackson (No massage), Trump (Not on island).
*   **2025 (Apr)**: **Virginia Giuffre dies** by suicide in Australia.
*   **2025 (Oct)**: **"Nobody's Girl"**, Giuffre's memoir, is published posthumously.
*   **2025 (Jul 23)**: House Oversight Subcommittee **unanimously votes** to subpoena Bill & Hillary Clinton.
*   **2025 (Aug 5)**: Chairman Comer issues Clinton subpoenas.
*   **2025 (Sep)**: **Bloomberg News** independently obtains ~18,700 Epstein emails from his Yahoo account, revealing depths of elite network.
*   **2025 (Sep)**: UK PM Starmer **sacks Peter Mandelson** as US Ambassador after initial Epstein ties surface.
*   **2025 (Oct)**: Supreme Court **denies** Maxwell's appeal; 20-year sentence stands.
*   **2025 (Nov 18)**: **Epstein Files Transparency Act** passes House (427-1) and Senate (unanimous).
*   **2025 (Nov 19)**: President Trump signs the Transparency Act into law.
*   **2025 (Dec 19)**: DOJ compliance deadline (largely missed; initial small release).
